# Historical Curation Receipts

These digest-addressed fixtures retain the exact log and prior-validation bytes
required by the two Halobacteria curation guards and their independent audit.
`source_paths` are repository-relative provenance identifiers, not read locations.
The original dated receipts and their recorded hashes are unchanged.

The reader accepts only registered receipt paths and matching SHA-256 content.
It never falls back to a historical workstation path or a local ignored log.
These are historical validation results, not passes for the current revision.
